definition: Process subtasks from last to first. For each subtask, search Post-grasp with Pre-grasp blocked, then search Pre-grasp while holding the finalized Post-grasp bounds. Each failed stage is diagnosed only on axes enabled by the task mask using bilateral zero trials, then corrected on the unique successful axis using running signed release extrema. Masked-out axes remain zero.

trial_context.authored_angle_use: enabled-axis mask only; search starts +/-30deg as shared MuJoCo annotator

scene.scene_source: original demo MJCF + recorded pre-action snapshot

release_measurement: per-stage running positive and negative maxima over every 20 Hz optimizer frame; endpoint-only release is not used
